---
title: "Finite Beam Model"
---

A dedicated section for the finite-beam formulation developed for jointed rigid-pavement and TSD response analysis. Planned topics include multiple slabs and joints, load-transfer efficiency, slab rocking, multiple TSD sensors, nonuniform properties, and composite pavements.


## Related Technical Article

[**RIGID-01 — What Does a TSD See When It Crosses a Concrete Pavement Joint?**](../posts/rigid-analytical-finite-beam/index.qmd)

Follow the progression from infinite-beam solutions to semi-infinite beams with one joint and then to an assembled analytical finite-beam formulation. The article includes original figures and animations.
